column1: # Revenga 1822 (catalogue 641): settled cipher transcription after the second pass (17 Nov 2026; work of 12 Nov 2026).
# B-numbering of the blind transcription, with the matching first-pass group (C-id). Every difference between the two
# transcriptions settled on the frame (collation.tsv). [..] or [?] = unread or open; [a|b] = open between a and b.
# ll = one sign (plain s); lll = ll + l; , = the comma-like mark; a = word space; w = the j sign (z_sign_test.md).
